newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends mixed, distant months lower.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends mixed, distant months lower.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Tuesday, as sporadic selling pressured distant months following weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen up. Benchmark November was off 1.4 yen at 135.7 yen.

"Weaker Thai rubber offer prices stimulated sporadic trade-house selling in distant months from the start," a trader said. Activity was lacklustre with most players staying on the sidelines amid a dearth of fresh incentives, the traders said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
